headline_item.title_zh: 纽约时报厨艺上线AI辅助食谱缩放
headline_item.title_en: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 纽约时报厨艺部门引入AI辅助食谱缩放与计量单位转换功能，尽管引发用户争议，但实际体验意外好用
headline_item.event_summary_en: NYT Cooking recently launched an AI-powered feature for recipe scaling and unit conversion, aimed at simplifying prep work. Despite intense backlash in the comment section over 'smart kitchen' fatigue, the feature has proven surprisingly reliable and functional in real-world usage.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】纽约时报厨艺 (NYT Cooking在线上食谱编辑与展示平台：上线基于AI的食谱缩放与单位转换功能)
【起因与机理】降低烹饪难度，优化内容呈现，但也引发了用户对于“技术介入厨房”的反感与防御心理
【关键技术规格】纽约时报厨艺引入AI辅助功能。
【观点态度】尽管用户初期抵制，实际表现却超预期。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] NYT Cooking (Online recipe management platform): Implemented AI-driven scaling and unit conversion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To improve content accessibility, though it triggered resistance against unnecessary kitchen tech
[Key Specification] NYT Cooking integrates AI features.
[Perspective & Impact] Feature is functional despite initial user backlash.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 科技圈定律：任何试图连接蓝牙的烤面包机通常都是灾难，但AI换算个分量确实比人类厨子算得快。用户骂的是又一个没用的付费订阅噱头，只要AI别自作主张把食谱里的盐换成草灰，这功能其实还能处。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The tech world's golden rule: any toaster with Bluetooth is a disaster, but AI doing kitchen math is surprisingly decent. Users are just venting over 'smart-kitchen' fatigue; as long as the AI doesn't hallucinate ingredients, it’s actually a rare useful gadget.

headlines.title_zh: 强化学习之父萨顿警告：仅靠算力堆叠无法通向AGI，AI必须转向真实世界交互
headlines.title_en: Turing Laureate Richard Sutton: Compute Scaling Alone Cannot Yield AGI, AI Must Ground in Reality
headlines.event_summary_zh: 图灵奖得主萨顿批评当前大模型盲目暴力堆算力，主张转向从真实世界交互中持续学习的智能体
headlines.event_summary_en: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton argued on social media that raw compute scaling alone won't lead to AGI. He criticized the reliance on synthetic data, advocating for AI agents that move beyond static internet text and learn continuously through complex real-world interactions.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】理查德·萨顿（图灵奖得主在社交媒体平台：批判暴力堆算力路线，提出AI应通过与真实世界交互实现持续进化）
【起因与机理】针对当前大模型Scaling Law陷入瓶颈、合成数据导致模型认知局限的现状
【关键技术规格】图灵奖得主反思Scaling Law局限。
【观点态度】提倡具备世界模型的持续学习智能体。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Richard Sutton (Social media platform): Criticized scaling laws; called for agentic world models learning from reality.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing the limits of static LLMs and synthetic data bottlenecks.
[Key Specification] Turing laureate questions scaling limits.
[Perspective & Impact] Advocates for continuous learning agents.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 萨顿老爷子当年一手教出了暴力美学信徒，现在又亲手反噬自己的“苦涩教训”。说白了，大厂们现在堆算力堆得像是在搞军备竞赛，但离真正的智慧其实还差着一个“走出舒适区”的距离。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Sutton once taught us that scale is all you need, but now he’s the one pulling the rug out from under the GPU-rich. It turns out that burning cash on synthetic data is just fancy digital hoarding; we're still lightyears away from a model that actually touches grass.

headlines.title_zh: 内蒙古成为中国AI算力核心枢纽
headlines.title_en: Inside Inner Mongolia, China's fastest-growing AI data center region, where construction is accelerating with low building cost and no public backlash (SemiAnalysis)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 内蒙古乌兰察布通过超低建设成本与极高效率，大规模承接中国科技巨头的千兆瓦级AI数据中心建设需求
headlines.event_summary_en: Inner Mongolia's Ulanqab is becoming the epicenter of China's AI infrastructure, with massive gigawatt-scale data center clusters under construction. The region delivers projects at one-fifth the cost of US counterparts with lightning speed, leveraging policy and geographic advantages without the public backlash seen in the West.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】中国科技巨头与内蒙古乌兰察布地方政府在内蒙古乌兰察布察哈尔高新区：建设规模达800MW的银河数据中心，首期120MW已投产，建设成本低廉且施工进度极快。
【起因与机理】AI大模型训练对电力与基础设施的渴求，促使算力中心向成本洼地和能源富集区战略迁移。
【关键技术规格】内蒙古乌兰察布成AI基建核心区。
【观点态度】无社会阻力助力算力规模高速扩张。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Chinese big tech firms and local government of Ulanqab: Building the 'Galaxy' campus with 800MW capacity, with phase one (120MW) delivered in under a year.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] The massive demand for AI training power and infrastructure drives the shift toward low-cost, energy-abundant regions.
[Key Metrics] Construction costs are 1/5th of US levels with superior speed.
[Perspective & Impact] Absence of local opposition accelerates hyper-scaling.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 一边是美国为建个电站吵得鸡飞狗跳，一边是内蒙古的大工地上3万人像搭积木一样垒起算力长城。当硅谷还在为环保审批磨洋工时，这里的电力和土地正用极低的成本，把AI赛道的红利按在地上疯狂输出。
headlines.industry_impact_en: While the US is stuck in endless zoning disputes, 30,000 workers in Inner Mongolia are stacking silicon cathedrals like Lego blocks. It’s a brutal reminder that in the AI arms race, the side with the lowest electricity price and the fewest 'not-in-my-backyard' protestors usually wins.

titans.quote_en:
RT @fedesarquis: You can try the prompt yourself! Here:

Create a seamless 4–5-second looping GIF celebrating [BRAND NAME], using the attached logo as the exact shape reference.

Center the logo on a near-black navy background. Rebuild it entirely from visible ASCII characters: @ # % * + = 0 1. Preserve its proportions, silhouette, and negative space. Keep the shape stable while the characters continuously shuffle.

Animate [BRAND COLORS] through the ASCII logo, accented by golden-yellow light. A brilliant white-gold highlight sweeps across the characters, creating a luminous bloom while keeping individual glyphs readable.

Surround it with electric-cyan and brand-colored ASCII characters flowing in an orbital trail. Add dramatic sparkling light: large four- and eight-point starbursts that flare and fade, smaller twinkling + characters, and occasional bright glints along the logo’s edges.

Beneath the logo, display “[BRAND NAME OR PRODUCT NAME]” in a crisp, stationary monospace font.

Square composition, smooth motion, seamless loop. Radiant retro-terminal aesthetic, strong contrast, generous breathing room. The developer’s logo is the unmistakable hero.
